notes: Campaign pilot-bsu1-v2 (6x6 cell). GM: flat Au8 island, all 8 Au in contact (thickness 0.3 A, Au-Au 2.74-2.83 A, Au-O 2.33 A), periodic-image gap 10.5 A. Tight re-relaxation (fmax 0.005) of all runs within 0.05 eV: 15 runs found the GM, with stored gaps 0-0.011 eV (scatter from fmax 0.05); distinct flat isomers lie at +0.019, +0.019, +0.021, +0.041 eV (tight; stored +0.020 to +0.044). e_tol 0.05 would count them as hits, so e_tol = 0.015 (budget = 3x the BH median hit at this e_tol). NEP89 checks: a single Au prefers O-top (Au-O 2.22 A; bridge +0.08 eV, Mg-top +0.22 eV), as in DFT; the best 3D Au8 isomers from 20 starts (fcc 6+2 bilayers) are >= 0.69 eV above the flat GM, while DFT finds 3D Au8 on bulk MgO(001). Dropped: 5x5 cell (Au8 and Au10 GMs were ribbons bonded to their own periodic image).
